'''Pter Vanteck''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a member of the maintenance team of the [[Imperial Monitoring Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Vanteck became an agent of the [[Friends of Paran]], an anti-Imperial resistance group, and shortly after the Friends came into contact with a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives, Vantack traveled to the [[Friends of Paran base]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Knellis]] and reported to the resistance group that he had heard word that the Empire were commencing an initiative called [[Operation: Elrood]]. Vanteck subsequently helped the Rebels and several Friends of Paran agents to infiltrate the Monitoring Garrison and steal [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] regarding the initiative.
